text:
ہالا پوے ترکال، ہالیا، ہل سنبھال۔
ہالا پوے دن چڑھے، ہالی ہل چا دھرے۔
romanized:
Hala pawe tirkal, halia, hal samhal.
Hala pawe din charhé, hali hal cha dharé.
literal_en:
If there be a rainbow in the evening, ploughman, get ready your plough.
If there be a rainbow at sunrise, the ploughman may lay by his plough.
meaning_en: i.e., it will rain; i.e., it will not rain.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
